title: [spec-bug][R-ADR-010] appendix-design-rationale.md:394 stale density >8 contradicts density-high decision (>10)
description: spec/appendix-design-rationale.md:394 (CCP-16 section): density-aware overrides and CH0 fallback apply only on explicit thresholds (density >8 triggers specific SF and control channel rules). The adjudicated decision density-high (spec/decisions.jsonl, 2026-08-31) sets DENSITY_HIGH >10; spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md:628,648 and all implementations (rf_health.rs:16 DENSITY_HIGH=10, link_ctx.c:716, gradient.c) already use 10. The appendix line is the last remaining spec-text >8 site (vector-description residue already tracked in b7z9.106). Found during appendix-design-rationale sweep. This section is not in the decision specs array, so the sweep could not edit the file (matrix + beads only). Suggested fix: change >8 to >10 at appendix line 394.
